title: Amazon Ring and Flock Safety cancel partnership
summary: Amazon Ring and Flock Safety jointly canceled their planned integration, announced less than six months earlier, that would have connected Flock's ALPR network with Ring's Community Requests footage-sharing feature. The cancellation follows public backlash over Flock's surveillance network and ICE cooperation, plus criticism of a Ring Super Bowl ad for an AI 'Search Party' feature.

key_quotes.quote: Following a comprehensive review, we determined the planned Flock Safety integration would require significantly more time and resources than anticipated. As a result, we have made the joint decision to cancel the planned integration.
The integration never launched, so no Ring customer videos were ever sent to Flock Safety.
The announcement follows months of public backlash over Flock Safety's surveillance network, which is used by federal agencies such as ICE and local law enforcement departments.
